title: UI Tips by @kianbazza: Sometimes, less is more. For high traffic areas, it's best to skip the
notes:
Sometimes, less is more. For high traffic areas, it's best to skip the hover transitions entirely. The benefits stack for components w/ grouped controls, such as a sidebar or button group. A small change on its own. But small changes compound.

Designer: @kianbazza. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
